I Really enjoy my stay here. The common area with the pool table has a great vibe. For a corporate traveler, the fast Wi-Fi and quiet, air-conditioned rooms were exactly what I needed.
The food actually tastes like a home-cooked meal, which is a rare find.

One of the best dormitories visited so far in Gurgaon. Cleanest bathroom ever seen in a dormitory. Vinay chauhan is the best Guy in the hotel, he is the night manager he would help you out in every situation. Good job done by the management.

Best dormitory ever very clean and neat.
Best staff ever they gave me very huge discount. Vinay chauhan he is the best manager we had in the dorms.
